quests.instruction: Black coffee and extra-dark chocolate share this strong, less-sweet taste. What's the word?
quests.question: Bitter
quests.hint: This taste often needs a partner, like sugar, to taste more pleasant.
quests.explanation: That's right! Black coffee and extra-dark chocolate both share this strong, less-sweet taste!
quests.funFact: Babies are born already disliking this taste more than any other!

quests.instruction: Oatmeal with no sugar or fruit stirred in has this simple taste. Which word matches?
quests.question: Plain
quests.hint: This is the taste of a food before any topping is added.
quests.explanation: Great job! Oatmeal without sugar or fruit has this same simple, nothing-added taste!
quests.funFact: A food like this is easy to turn into any flavor you like, just by adding toppings!

quests.instruction: A ripe banana and apple pie both share this sugary taste. What word fits best?
quests.question: Sweet
quests.hint: It's the taste balanced out by its sour opposite in many recipes.
quests.explanation: You got it! A ripe banana and apple pie are both sugary treats, matching this taste word!
quests.funFact: Chefs often mix this taste with a sour one to make desserts extra interesting!

quests.instruction: Birthday cake and candy both taste very sugary. Which word describes that taste?
quests.question: Sweet
quests.hint: Think about how honey or ripe fruit makes your tongue feel.
quests.explanation: Well done! Cake and candy are both full of sugar, and that sugary taste is called sweet!
quests.funFact: Our tongues have special taste buds just for noticing this yummy taste!

quests.instruction: Potato chips and pretzels share a taste from a shaker on the table. What is it?
quests.question: Salty
quests.hint: It's the taste that can make you feel thirsty afterward.
quests.explanation: Correct! Chips and pretzels are both sprinkled with the taste that comes from a shaker on the table!
quests.funFact: Our bodies actually need a tiny bit of this taste to work properly!

quests.instruction: Dark leafy greens and plain dark chocolate share this less-sweet taste. Which word fits?
quests.question: Bitter
quests.hint: This taste is often an acquired one, meaning people grow to like it slowly.
quests.explanation: Super! Dark leafy greens and plain dark chocolate both carry this less-sweet taste!
quests.funFact: Chefs sometimes pair this taste with something sweet to balance a whole dish!

quests.instruction: Hot chili peppers and jalapenos can make your mouth feel like it's on fire. What word fits?
quests.question: Spicy
quests.hint: This taste might make you reach for a glass of milk.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Chili peppers and jalapenos both bring the fiery taste this word describes!
quests.funFact: Milk can cool down this fiery taste better than water can!

quests.instruction: Soy sauce and salted crackers share this savory taste. Which word fits?
quests.question: Salty
quests.hint: It's a taste you might sprinkle onto your fries.
quests.explanation: You found it! Soy sauce and salted crackers both share this same savory taste!
quests.funFact: Sailors long ago used this seasoning to keep meat and fish fresh on long trips!

quests.instruction: Kale and dark chocolate with very little sugar share this sharp taste. What word fits?
quests.question: Bitter
quests.hint: This taste can make some people's face scrunch up a little.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Kale and low-sugar dark chocolate both share this sharp taste!
quests.funFact: Our taste buds are extra good at noticing this taste, to help keep us safe!

quests.instruction: Unsweetened tea and dark cocoa powder share this less-sweet taste. What's it called?
quests.question: Bitter
quests.hint: This taste is often softened with a spoonful of honey.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Unsweetened tea and dark cocoa powder both share this less-sweet taste!
quests.funFact: This taste can be a warning sign that a plant might not be safe to eat!

quests.instruction: Crackers with no cheese or dip and water with nothing mixed in share this taste. What's it called?
quests.question: Plain
quests.hint: This word means as simple and basic as a food can be.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Crackers alone and water alone are both this way, with nothing extra added!
quests.funFact: Bakers make crackers this way on purpose, so people can add their own toppings!

quests.instruction: French fries and movie popcorn share this savory taste. What's it called?
quests.question: Salty
quests.hint: This taste often makes you want a drink of water.
quests.explanation: Yes! French fries and movie popcorn are both sprinkled with this savory taste!
quests.funFact: This taste comes from tiny white crystals mined from the earth or the sea!

quests.instruction: A curry dish and hot sauce both bring the same fiery taste. What's the word?
quests.question: Spicy
quests.hint: This taste often comes with a warning on the menu.
quests.explanation: That's right! Curry and hot sauce both bring the same fiery kick described by this word!
quests.funFact: Some peppers are so fiery that people wear gloves just to chop them!

quests.instruction: Unripe grapes and cranberries both have a sharp, tart taste. What's it called?
quests.question: Sour
quests.hint: This taste often shows up before a fruit is fully ripe.
quests.explanation: Great job! Unripe grapes and cranberries share that same tart, sharp taste!
quests.funFact: Ripening in the sun can turn this tart taste into a sweet one!

quests.instruction: A plain grilled chicken breast without spices has a gentle taste. What word describes it?
quests.question: Mild
quests.hint: This is the taste of food before any bold seasoning is added.
quests.explanation: You got it! Plain grilled chicken without spices has this gentle taste!
quests.funFact: Cooks often season this kind of gentle-tasting food to give it more flavor!

quests.instruction: A pretzel and a briny olive share this taste. What's the word?
quests.question: Salty
quests.hint: This taste is often added to popcorn right after it pops.
quests.explanation: Well done! Pretzels and briny olives both share this classic taste!
quests.funFact: This seasoning is one of the oldest flavorings people have ever used!

quests.instruction: Grapes and mangoes both taste sugary when they're ripe. Which taste word is that?
quests.question: Sweet
quests.hint: Fruit tastes more like this the riper and juicier it gets.
quests.explanation: Correct! Ripe grapes and mangoes are full of natural sugar, so this taste word fits perfectly!
quests.funFact: Plants grow fruit with this taste to attract animals to spread their seeds!

quests.instruction: A fiery taco sauce and pepper-crusted steak share this bite. What word describes it?
quests.question: Spicy
quests.hint: This taste is often balanced out with something cool and creamy, like yogurt.
quests.explanation: Super! Fiery taco sauce and pepper-crusted steak both bring this bold bite!
quests.funFact: Bread or rice can help cool down this fiery taste better than water!

quests.instruction: Cream cheese with nothing mixed in and a tortilla with no filling share this basic taste. What word matches?
quests.question: Plain
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of a food loaded with bold flavors.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Plain cream cheese and an empty tortilla both share this basic taste!
quests.funFact: Bakeries often make foods this way so people can choose their own flavors to add!

quests.instruction: Hot salsa and buffalo wings share a fiery kick. Which taste word matches?
quests.question: Spicy
quests.hint: This taste can make your eyes water a little.
quests.explanation: You found it! Hot salsa and buffalo wings both share that same fiery kick!
quests.funFact: This fiery feeling isn't really a flavor — it's your mouth sensing a little heat!

quests.instruction: Cheese puffs and roasted nuts share this crunchy, savory taste. What word matches?
quests.question: Salty
quests.hint: This taste is the opposite of a taste with no flavor added at all.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Cheese puffs and roasted nuts both share this crunchy, savory taste!
quests.funFact: There's a tiny bit of this taste hiding in ocean water!

quests.instruction: A tart cherry and buttermilk share a tangy taste. Which word describes it?
quests.question: Sour
quests.hint: It's the taste that's the opposite of sugary and sweet.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Tart cherries and buttermilk both share that same tangy taste!
quests.funFact: Chefs balance this tangy taste with a little sugar in many recipes!

quests.instruction: Hot chili sauce and hot peppers bring this fiery taste. What word describes it?
quests.question: Spicy
quests.hint: It's the taste that might make your nose start to run.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Hot chili sauce and hot peppers both bring this fiery taste!
quests.funFact: This fiery taste comes from a natural chemical hiding inside certain peppers!

quests.instruction: Marshmallows and birthday frosting share the same sugary flavor. What's the word?
quests.question: Sweet
quests.hint: It's a taste kids usually ask for seconds of.
quests.explanation: Yes! Marshmallows and frosting are both packed with sugar, matching this taste word exactly!
quests.funFact: Eating too much of this taste in one day isn't great for your teeth!

quests.instruction: Cocoa nibs and the white pith inside an orange peel share this sharp taste. What word fits?
quests.question: Bitter
quests.hint: This taste is why a lot of coffee gets cream stirred into it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cocoa nibs and orange pith both share this sharp, less-sweet taste!
quests.funFact: This taste is one of the five basic tastes your tongue can notice!

quests.instruction: Boiled potatoes without butter or salt have a very gentle taste. Which word matches?
quests.question: Mild
quests.hint: This taste is soft and calm, not bold or exciting.
quests.explanation: Great job! Boiled potatoes without butter or salt have this very gentle taste!
quests.funFact: Cooks often build bold flavors starting from a gentle-tasting food like this!

quests.instruction: A pickle and cured ham share this savory taste. What is that taste called?
quests.question: Salty
quests.hint: Chips at a party are almost always sprinkled with this taste.
quests.explanation: You got it! Pickles and cured ham both share this savory taste!
quests.funFact: This seasoning has been used to keep food fresh for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Yogurt with nothing sweet mixed in and popcorn with no butter or salt share this taste. What's the word?
quests.question: Plain
quests.hint: This word means nothing extra has been added at all.
quests.explanation: Well done! Unsweetened yogurt and butter-free popcorn both have nothing extra added, exactly what this word means!
quests.funFact: Cooks often start with food like this, then add their own flavors!

quests.instruction: Pepper jack cheese and hot wings share this fiery bite. Which word fits?
quests.question: Spicy
quests.hint: This is the opposite of a taste with barely any flavor at all.
quests.explanation: Correct! Pepper jack cheese and hot wings both bring this same fiery bite!
quests.funFact: Scientists use a special scale just for measuring how fiery this taste can get!

quests.instruction: Plain yogurt and grapefruit both have a tangy bite. Which taste word fits?
quests.question: Sour
quests.hint: This taste can make your whole face scrunch up.
quests.explanation: Super! Plain yogurt and grapefruit share that same tangy bite!
quests.funFact: Bakers sometimes add a little of this taste to balance very sweet treats!
